scenario.topic: Choose the paint color for the community center main hall

options.name: Soft Cream
options.upside: Creates a welcoming atmosphere and is easy to maintain.
options.concern: May show dirt more quickly than darker colors.

options.name: Cool Gray
options.upside: Provides a modern, versatile backdrop suitable for various events.
options.concern: Could feel less warm or inviting to some users.

options.name: Sky Blue
options.upside: Brightens the space and promotes a calm environment.
options.concern: Requires more frequent touch-ups due to medium durability.

options.name: Earthy Green
options.upside: Adds a natural feel and is resistant to wear.
options.concern: May limit color coordination with some decorations.

shared_context: The community center main hall needs a new paint color that is durable and suitable for diverse activities. Six participants will decide among four color options that vary in brightness, maintenance, and ambiance.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a community event coordinator focused on creating welcoming spaces.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the hall feels warm and inviting while minimizing upkeep effort.

A.reason_for: Creates a welcoming atmosphere and is easy to maintain, fitting my goal perfectly.

B.reason_for: Durable and modern, but less warm and inviting.
B.reason_against: Could feel less welcoming for community events.

C.reason_against: Medium durability means more maintenance, which I want to avoid.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a facilities manager prioritizing durability and ease of maintenance.
personas.private_goal: Choose a color that resists wear and requires minimal upkeep.

A.reason_against: Shows dirt more quickly than darker colors.

B.reason_against: Less warm atmosphere might reduce comfort.

C.reason_for: Bright and calming but only medium durability.

D.reason_for: High durability, easy maintenance, and natural feel.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a youth program leader who values bright, calming environments.
personas.private_goal: Select a color that energizes and soothes participants during activities.

A.reason_against: Medium brightness is less uplifting than Sky Blue.

B.reason_against: Low brightness and less inviting atmosphere.

C.reason_for: Brightens space and promotes calm, ideal for youth activities.

D.reason_against: May limit decoration options and less bright.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a local artist interested in colors that inspire creativity and comfort.
personas.private_goal: Find a color that balances warmth and versatility for diverse uses.

A.reason_for: Warm and welcoming, easy to maintain, suits many activities.

C.reason_for: Bright and calming, good for creative energy.

D.reason_for: Natural and durable with easy maintenance.

personas.name: Nia
personas.background: Nia is a wellness coach who values calm and uplifting environments.
personas.private_goal: Choose a color that promotes relaxation and positivity.

A.reason_against: Medium brightness less calming than Sky Blue.

B.reason_for: Durable but less bright and inviting.

C.reason_for: Brightens space and promotes calm atmosphere.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a community elder who prefers practical, long-lasting solutions.
personas.private_goal: Select a durable, low-maintenance color that suits all users.

B.reason_for: High durability and modern, suits diverse activities.

acceptance_reasons.C: Bright and calming, good for creative energy.
acceptance_reasons.D: Natural and durable with easy maintenance.
